# `surface-table` content schema

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from the "surface-table" schema in src/content/registry.ts; do not edit. -->

One JSON file per entry in `src/content/data/surface-table/`. Fields marked "required" must be present;
every other field takes the default shown when omitted ("—" = stays absent).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | id | required | Unique table id; the game reads "surfaces". |
| `notes` | string | required | Where the numbers come from (bead, tuning status). |
| `surfaces` | list of object (at least 1) | required | One row per footstep surface of the audio bible §7.3: all of them, each once. |
| `surfaces[].id` | `"stone"` \| `"wood"` \| `"wood-hollow"` \| `"dirt"` \| `"grass"` \| `"gravel"` \| `"mud"` \| `"water-shallow"` \| `"snow-ice"` \| `"metal-grate"` \| `"straw"` \| `"carpet"` \| `"bone-litter"` \| `"leaves"` \| `"glass-shards"` | required | Footstep surface id (audio bible §7.3). |
| `surfaces[].offsetDb` | number -20–20 | required | Loudness offset relative to stone, dB, −20 to +20. |
| `surfaces[].varianceDb` | number 0–6 | required | Step-to-step spread of the loudness, dB (± this much, seeded), 0–6. |
| `surfaces[].sfx` | string | required | Sound set id the audio layer plays for this surface, e.g. "sfx-foot-carpet". |
| `surfaces[].creak` | object | — | A board that sometimes betrays the step: a seeded chance of an extra loud step. |
| `surfaces[].creak.chance` | number > 0 ≤ 1 | required | Probability per step of a creak, 0–1 (seeded). |
| `surfaces[].creak.db` | number > 0 ≤ 20 | required | Extra loudness of a creaking step, dB. |
